name: Coral Boswellia
headline: Coral Boswellia
description: Boswellia is a small tree native to India and Southeast Asia. Its resin contains boswellic acids, which help calm inflammatory processes, improve the nourishment of joint tissue and ease pain and stiffness.
howToUse: Adults – 1 capsule three times a day with food.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
